text: Mostly yes, one exception. Live now (frames within the last 10 s): PropLine's stream, ParlayAPI's stream, Kalshi's socket (11,755 of 11,755 markets) and SX Bet. BoltOdds is NOT live: both its lines and props sockets show 'wanted but not live'. SharpAPI's socket is off in your settings. Two things to know: ParlayAPI's per-league sockets keep being reset or closed by ParlayAPI after 13-16 s, though its book feed is current and the engine reconnects. PropLine logged one 'connection limit reached' close (your Streaming Lite tier allows 2 streams, we hold 5-6), so that could drop out again. I'll look into BoltOdds next; if its key or its 3-connection limit is the cause, that may need you to check the key.
